{{Quote|The Selkath are everywhere! It's like a bad krek beetle infestation.|[[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Anri]]|<ref name="TOR:Retaliation">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=faction|Imperial|Retaliation|Manaan}}</ref>}}
'''Krek beetles''' were insects native to [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]]. They were the basis for a [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] metaphor.
